findings.failureScenario: Import caps a sidecar at MAX_SIDECAR_BYTES (4 MiB, import.rs:648-662), but read_packet (photo.readMetadataFromFile and other re-reads) reads any found .xmp whole with read_to_string, and for raws reads the entire original into memory; sidecar_contents (every save and XMP auto-write) likewise std::fs::read()s the existing sidecar unbounded. A hostile or corrupt multi-GB IMG_0001.xmp next to a photo makes the allocation fail, which aborts the process: a local file turns a metadata command into a crash, against the repo's own 'cap allocations sized by input' rule.
findings.action: Route read_packet and sidecar_contents through the same bounded reader as import (read_sidecar_packet with MAX_SIDECAR_BYTES) and return an actionable error when the sidecar is larger.
